      "end": 16.62,
      "text": "Two year ago, my life changed forever."
    },
    {
      "start": 16.62,
      "end": 23.03,
      "text": "My wife Kelsey and I welcomed our daughter Lela into the world."
    },
    {
      "start": 23.03,
      "end": 27.45,
      "text": "Now, becoming a parent is an amazing experience."
    },
    {
      "start": 27.46,
      "end": 30.71,
      "text": "Your whole world changes over night."
    },
    {
      "start": 30.7,
      "end": 33.28,
      "text": "And all of your priorities change immediately."
    },
    {
      "start": 33.28,
      "end": 39.29,
      "text": "So fast that it makes it really difficult to process sometimes."
    },
    {
      "start": 39.29,
      "end": 46.82,
      "text": "Now, you also have to learn a tremendous amount about being a parent like, for example, how to dress your child."
    },
    {
      "start": 46.82,
      "end": 47.95,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 47.95,
      "end": 50.09,
      "text": "This was new to me."
    },
    {
      "start": 50.09,
      "end": 53.84,
      "text": "This is an actual outfit,  I thought this was a good idea."
    },
    {
      "start": 53.84,
      "end": 57.89,
      "text": "And even Lela knows that it's not a good idea."
    },
    {
      "start": 57.89,
      "end": 64.41,
      "text": "(Laughter) So there is so much to learn and so much craziness all at once."
    },
    {
      "start": 64.41,
      "end": 71.22,
      "text": "And to add to the craziness,  Kelsey and I both work from home, we're entrepreneurs, we run our own businesses."
    },
    {
      "start": 71.22,
      "end": 76.99,
      "text": "So, Kelsey develops courses online for yoga teachers."
    },
    {
      "start": 76.99,
      "end": 78.33,
      "text": "I'm an author."
    },
    {
      "start": 78.33,
      "end": 80.78,
      "text": "And so, I'm working from home, Kelsey's working from home."
    },
    {
      "start": 80.78,
      "end": 86.72,
      "text": "We have an infant and we're trying to make sure that everything gets done that needs done."
    },
    {
      "start": 86.72,
      "end": 91.1,
      "text": "And life is really, really busy."
    },
    {
      "start": 92.36,
      "end": 118.06,
      "text": "And a couple of weeks into this amazing experience, when the sleep deprivation really kicked in, like around week eight, I had this thought, and it was the same thought that parents across the ages, internationally, everybody has had this thought, which is: I am never going to have free time ever again."
    },
    {
      "start": 118.05,
      "end": 119.18,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 119.18,
      "end": 122.4,
      "text": "Somebody said it's true."
    },
    {
      "start": 122.4,
      "end": 129.86,
      "text": "It's not exactly true, but it feels really, really true in that moment."
    },
    {
      "start": 129.87,
      "end": 139.42,
      "text": "And this was really disconcerning to me, because one of the things that I enjoy more than anything else is learning new things."
    },
    {
      "start": 139.43,
      "end": 145.16,
      "text": "Getting curious about something and diving in and fiddling around and  learning through trial and error."
    },
    {
      "start": 145.16,
      "end": 148.44,
      "text": "And eventually becoming pretty good at something."
    },
    {
      "start": 148.44,
      "end": 156.41,
      "text": "And without this free time, I didn't know how I was ever  going to do that ever again."
    },
    {
      "start": 156.41,
      "end": 162.07,
      "text": "And so, I'm a big geek, I want to keep learning things, I want to keep growing."
    },
    {
      "start": 162.07,
      "end": 173.52,
      "text": "And so what I've decided to do was, go to the library, and go to the bookstore, and look at what research says about how we learn and how we learn quickly."
    },
    {
      "start": 173.52,
      "end": 176.83,
      "text": "And I read a bunch of books, I read a bunch of websites."
    },
    {
      "start": 176.83,
      "end": 183.04,
      "text": "And tried to answer this question, how long does it take to acquire a new skill?"
    },
    {
      "start": 183.04,
      "end": 185.12,
      "text": "You know what I found?"
    },
    {
      "start": 185.12,
      "end": 189.44,
      "text": "10,000 hours!"
    },
    {
      "start": 189.44,
      "end": 191.2,
      "text": "Anybody ever heard this?"
    },
    {
      "start": 191.2,
      "end": 192.31,
      "text": "It takes 10,000 hours."
    },
    {
      "start": 192.31,
      "end": 197.93,
      "text": "If you want to learn something new, if you want to be good at it, it's going to take 10,000 hours to get there."
    },
    {
      "start": 197.93,
      "end": 201.45,
      "text": "And I read this in book after book, in website after website."
    },
    {
      "start": 201.46,
      "end": 210.8,
      "text": "And my mental experience of reading all of this stuff was like: No!!"
    },
    {
      "start": 210.8,
      "end": 212.33,
      "text": "I don't have time!"
    },
    {
      "start": 212.33,
      "end": 214.54,
      "text": "I don't have 10,000 hours."
    },
    {
      "start": 214.54,
      "end": 219.09,
      "text": "I am never going to be able to learn anything new."
    },
    {
      "start": 219.09,
      "end": 220.24,
      "text": "Ever again."
    },
    {
      "start": 220.24,
      "end": 223.48,
      "text": "(Laughter) But that's not true."
    },
    {
      "start": 223.48,
      "end": 232.42,
      "text": "So, 10,000 hours, just to give you a rough order of magnitude, 10,000 hours is a full-time job for five years."
    },
    {
      "start": 232.42,
      "end": 234.01,
      "text": "That's a long time."
    },
    {
      "start": 234.01,
      "end": 240.44,
      "text": "And we've all had the experience of learning something new, and it didn't take us anywhere close to that amount of time, right?"
    },
    {
      "start": 240.44,
      "end": 241.18,
      "text": "So, what's up?"
    },
    {
      "start": 241.18,
      "end": 243.51,
      "text": "There's something kinda funky going on here."
    },
    {
      "start": 243.5,
      "end": 249.42,
      "text": "What the research says and what we expect, and have experiences, they don't match up."
    },
    {
      "start": 249.42,
      "end": 259.72,
      "text": "And what I found, here's the wrinkle: The 10,000 hour rule came out of studies of expert-level performance."
    },
    {
      "start": 259.72,
      "end": 263.32,
      "text": "There's a professor at Florida State University, his name is K."
    },
    {
      "start": 263.32,
      "end": 264.23,
      "text": "Anders Ericsson."
    },
    {
      "start": 264.23,
      "end": 266.73,
      "text": "He is the originator of the 10,00 hour rule."
    },
    {
      "start": 266.73,
      "end": 275.76,
      "text": "And where that came from is, he studied professional athletes, world class musicians, chess grand masters."
    },
    {
      "start": 275.76,
      "end": 280.77,
      "text": "All of this ultra competitive folks in ultra-high performing fields."
    },
    {
      "start": 280.77,
      "end": 286.81,
      "text": "And he tried to figure out how long does it take to get to the top of those kinds of fields."
    },
    {
      "start": 286.81,
      "end": 297.24,
      "text": "And what he found is, the more deliberate practice, the more time that those individuals spend practicing the elements of whatever it is that they do, the more time you spend, the better you get."
    },
    {
      "start": 297.25,
      "end": 305.11,
      "text": "And the folks at the tippy top of their fields put in around 10,000 hours of practice."
    },
    {
      "start": 305.1,
      "end": 309.44,
      "text": "Now, we were talking about the game of telephone a little bit earlier."
    },
    {
      "start": 309.44,
      "end": 321.59,
      "text": "Here's what happened: an author by the name of Malcolm Gladwell wrote a book in 2007 called \"Outliers: The Story of Success\", and the central piece of that book was the 10,000 hour rule."
    },
    {
      "start": 321.59,
      "end": 327.37,
      "text": "Practice a lot, practice well, and you will do extremely well, you will reach the top of your field."
    },
    {
      "start": 327.37,
      "end": 341.86,
      "text": "So, the message, what Dr. Ericsson was actually saying is, it takes 10,000 hours to get at the top of an ultra competitive field in a very narrow subject, that's what that means."
    },
    {
      "start": 341.86,
      "end": 350.06,
      "text": "But here's what happened: ever since Outliers came out, immediately came out, reached the top of best seller lists, stayed there for three solid months."
    },
    {
      "start": 350.06,
      "end": 354.18,
      "text": "All of a sudden the 10,000 hour rule was everywhere."
    },
    {
      "start": 354.17,
      "end": 360.02,
      "text": "And a society-wide game of telephone started to be played."
    },
    {
      "start": 360.02,
      "end": 381.45,
      "text": "So this message, it takes 10,000 hours to reach the top of an ultra competitive field, became, it takes 10,000 hours to become an expert at something, which became, it takes 10,000 hours to become good at something, which became, it takes 10,000 hours to learn something."
    },
    {
      "start": 381.45,
      "end": 387.52,
      "text": "But that last statement, it takes 10,000 hours to learn something, is not true."
    },
    {
      "start": 387.52,
      "end": 388.6,
      "text": "It's not true."
    },
    {
      "start": 388.6,
      "end": 399.53,
      "text": "So, what the research actually says -- I spent a lot of time here at the CSU library in the cognitive psychology stacks 'cause I'm a geek."
    },
    {
      "start": 399.52,
      "end": 408.04,
      "text": "And when you actually look at the studies of skill acquisition, you see over and over a graph like this."
    },
    {
      "start": 408.04,
      "end": 417.18,
      "text": "Now, researchers, whether they're studying a motor skill, something you do physically or a mental skill, they like to study things that they can time."
    },
    {
      "start": 417.17,
      "end": 419.18,
      "text": "'Cause you can quantify that, right?"
    },
    {
      "start": 419.19,
      "end": 433.36,
      "text": "So, they'll give research participants a little task, something that requires physical arrangement, or something that requires learning a little mental trick, and they'll time how long a participant takes to complete the skill."
    },
    {
      "start": 433.36,
      "end": 443.05,
      "text": "And here's what this graph says, when you start -- so when researchers gave participants a task, it took them a really long time, 'cause it was new and they were horrible."
    },
    {
      "start": 443.05,
      "end": 446.65,
      "text": "With a little bit of practice, they get better and better and better."
    },
    {
      "start": 446.65,
      "end": 450.63,
      "text": "And that early part of practice is really, really efficient."
    },
    {
      "start": 450.63,
      "end": 456.02,
      "text": "People get good at things with just a little bit of practice."
    },
    {
      "start": 456.02,
      "end": 465.74,
      "text": "Now, what's interesting to note is that, for skills that we want to learn for ourselves, we don't care so much about time, right?"
    },
    {
      "start": 465.74,
      "end": 469.29,
      "text": "We just care about how good we are, whatever good happens to mean."
    },
    {
      "start": 469.28,
      "end": 481.28,
      "text": "So if we relabel performance time to how good you are, the graph flips, and you get his famous and widely known, this is the learning curve."
    },
    {
      "start": 481.27,
      "end": 486.56,
      "text": "And the story of the learning curve is when you start, you're grossly incompetent and you know it, right?"
    },
    {
      "start": 486.57,
      "end": 488.64,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 488.63,
      "end": 491.99,
      "text": "With a little bit of practice, you get really good, really quick."
    },
    {
      "start": 492.0,
      "end": 495.72,
      "text": "So that early level of improvement is really fast."
    },
    {
      "start": 495.71,
      "end": 504.66,
      "text": "And then at a certain point you reach a plateau, and the subsequent games become much harder to get, they take more time to get."
    },
    {
      "start": 504.66,
      "end": 508.62,
      "text": "Now, my question is, I want that, right?"
    },
    {
      "start": 508.62,
      "end": 517.57,
      "text": "How long does it take from starting something and being grossly incompetent and knowing it to being reasonably good?"
    },
    {
      "start": 517.58,
      "end": 522.33,
      "text": "In hopefully, as short a period of time as possible."
    },
    {
      "start": 522.33,
      "end": 524.54,
      "text": "So, how long does that take?"
    },
    {
      "start": 524.54,
      "end": 529.52,
      "text": "Here's what my research says: 20 hours."
    },
    {
      "start": 529.52,
      "end": 530.3,
      "text": "That's it."
    },
    {
      "start": 530.3,
      "end": 535.74,
      "text": "You can go from knowing nothing about any skill that you can think of."
    },
    {
      "start": 535.74,
      "end": 537.43,
      "text": "Want to learn a language?"
    },
    {
      "start": 537.43,
      "end": 539.18,
      "text": "Want to learn how to draw?"
    },
    {
      "start": 539.17,
      "end": 542.29,
      "text": "Want to learn how to juggle flaming chainsaws?"
    },
    {
      "start": 542.29,
      "end": 543.32,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 543.32,
      "end": 550.96,
      "text": "If you put 20 hours of focused deliberate practice into that thing, you will be astounded."
    },
    {
      "start": 550.96,
      "end": 554.13,
      "text": "Astounded at how good you are."
    },
    {
      "start": 554.13,
      "end": 559.95,
      "text": "20 hours is doable, that's about 45 minutes a day for about a month."
    },
    {
      "start": 559.96,
      "end": 562.07,
      "text": "Even skipping a couple days, here and there."
    },
    {
      "start": 562.07,
      "end": 565.22,
      "text": "20 hours isn't that hard to accumulate."
    },
    {
      "start": 565.22,
      "end": 568.1,
      "text": "Now, there's a method to doing this."
    },
    {
      "start": 568.1,
      "end": 573.05,
      "text": "Because it's not like you can just start fiddling around for about 20 hours and expect these massive improvements."
    },
    {
      "start": 573.04,
      "end": 575.71,
      "text": "There's a way to practice intelligently."
    },
    {
      "start": 575.71,
      "end": 583.59,
      "text": "There's a way to practice efficiently, that will make sure that you invest those 20 hours in the most effective way that you possibly can."
    },
    {
      "start": 583.59,
      "end": 591.37,
      "text": "And here's the method, it applies to anything: The first is to deconstruct the skill."
    },
    {
      "start": 591.36,
      "end": 602.07,
      "text": "Decide exactly what you want to be able to do when you're done, and then look into the skill and break it down into smaller pieces."
    },
    {
      "start": 602.07,
      "end": 610.64,
      "text": "Most of the things that we think of as skills are actually big bundles of skills that require all sorts of different things."
    },
    {
      "start": 610.64,
      "end": 621.36,
      "text": "The more you can break apart the skill, the more you're able to decide, what are the parts of this skill that would actually help me get to what I want?"
    },
    {
      "start": 621.37,
      "end": 623.76,
      "text": "And then you can practice those first."
    },
    {
      "start": 623.76,
      "end": 631.5,
      "text": "And if you practice the most important things first, you'll be able to improve your performance in the least amount of time possible."
    },
    {
      "start": 631.5,
      "end": 634.27,
      "text": "The second is, learn enough to self correct."
    },
    {
      "start": 634.27,
      "end": 638.46,
      "text": "So, get three to five resources about what it is you're trying to learn."
    },
    {
      "start": 638.47,
      "end": 643.72,
      "text": "Could be book, could be DVDs, could be courses, could be anything."
    },
    {
      "start": 643.72,
      "end": 648.95,
      "text": "But don't use those as a way to procrastinate on practice."
    },
    {
      "start": 648.95,
      "end": 650.59,
      "text": "I know I do this, right?"
    },
    {
      "start": 650.59,
      "end": 657.62,
      "text": "Get like 20 books about the topic, like, \"I'm going to start learning how to program a computer when I complete these 20 books\"."
    },
    {
      "start": 657.62,
      "end": 660.1,
      "text": "No. That's procrastination."
    },
    {
      "start": 660.09,
      "end": 670.91,
      "text": "What you want to do is learn just enough that you can actually practice and self correct or self edit as you practice."
    },
    {
      "start": 670.91,
      "end": 679.63,
      "text": "So the learning becomes a way of getting better at noticing when you're making a mistake and then doing something a little different."
    },
    {
      "start": 679.63,
      "end": 684.11,
      "text": "The third is to remove barriers to practice."
    },
    {
      "start": 684.11,
      "end": 686.55,
      "text": "Distractions, television, internet."
    },
    {
      "start": 686.55,
      "end": 693.31,
      "text": "All of these things that get in the way of you actually sitting down and doing the work."
    },
    {
      "start": 693.31,
      "end": 706.27,
      "text": "And the more you're able to use just a little bit of willpower to remove the distractions that are keeping you from practicing, the more likely you are to actually sit down and practice, right?"
    },
    {
      "start": 706.27,
      "end": 711.47,
      "text": "And the fourth is to practice for at least 20 hours."
    },
    {
      "start": 711.47,
      "end": 714.77,
      "text": "Now, most skills have what I call a frustration barrier."
    },
    {
      "start": 714.77,
      "end": 718.08,
      "text": "You know, the grossly-incompetent- and-knowing-it part?"
    },
    {
      "start": 718.08,
      "end": 720.4,
      "text": "That's really, really frustrating."
    },
    {
      "start": 720.4,
      "end": 722.38,
      "text": "We don't like to feel stupid."
    },
    {
      "start": 722.37,
      "end": 727.31,
      "text": "And feeling stupid is a barrier to us  actually sitting down and doing the work."
    },
    {
      "start": 727.31,
      "end": 743.03,
      "text": "So, by pre-committing to practicing whatever it is that you want to do for at least 20 hours, you will be able to overcome that initial frustration barrier and stick with the practice long enough to actually reap the rewards."
    },
    {
      "start": 743.03,
      "end": 743.72,
      "text": "That's it!"
    },
    {
      "start": 743.72,
      "end": 745.37,
      "text": "It's not rocket science."
    },
    {
      "start": 745.37,
      "end": 750.48,
      "text": "Four very simple steps that you can use to learn anything."
    },
    {
      "start": 751.47,
      "end": 757.7,
      "text": "Now, this is easy to talk about in theory, but it's more fun to talk about in practice."
    },
    {
      "start": 757.7,
      "end": 764.16,
      "text": "So one of the things that I've wanted to learn how to do for a long time is play the ukulele."
    },
    {
      "start": 764.16,
      "end": 772.26,
      "text": "Has anybody seen Jake Shimabukuro's TEDTalk where he plays the ukulele and makes it sound like -- he's like a ukulele god."
    },
    {
      "start": 772.26,
      "end": 774.03,
      "text": "It's amazing."
    },
    {
      "start": 774.03,
      "end": 777.21,
      "text": "I saw it, I was like, \"That is so cool!\""
    },
    {
      "start": 777.21,
      "end": 778.9,
      "text": "It's such a neat instrument."
    },
    {
      "start": 778.9,
      "end": 781.38,
      "text": "I would really like to learn how to play."
    },
    {
      "start": 781.37,
      "end": 789.82,
      "text": "And so I decided that to test this theory I wanted to put 20 hours into practicing ukulele and see where it got."
    },
    {
      "start": 789.82,
      "end": 797.7,
      "text": "And so the first thing about playing the ukulele is, in order to practice, you have to have one, right?"
    },
    {
      "start": 797.7,
      "end": 801.79,
      "text": "So, I got an ukulele and -- My lovely assistant?"
    },
    {
      "start": 801.79,
      "end": 804.52,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 804.53,
      "end": 806.26,
      "text": "Thank you sir."
    },
    {
      "start": 806.26,
      "end": 809.98,
      "text": "I think I need the chord here."
    },
    {
      "start": 811.58,
      "end": 815.87,
      "text": "It's not just an ukulele, it's an electric ukulele."
    },
    {
      "start": 815.87,
      "end": 817.21,
      "text": "(Laughter) Yeah."
    },
    {
      "start": 820.63,
      "end": 825.19,
      "text": "So, the first couple hours are just like the first couple hours of anything."
    },
    {
      "start": 825.2,
      "end": 828.56,
      "text": "You have to get the tools that you are using to practice."
    },
    {
      "start": 828.55,
      "end": 830.61,
      "text": "You have to make sure they're available."
    },
    {
      "start": 830.62,
      "end": 832.59,
      "text": "My ukulele didn't come with strings attached."
    },
    {
      "start": 832.58,
      "end": 834.55,
      "text": "I had to figure out how to put those on."
    },
    {
      "start": 834.55,
      "end": 836.52,
      "text": "Like, that's kind of important, right?"
    },
    {
      "start": 836.51,
      "end": 844.51,
      "text": "And learning how to tune, learning how to make sure that all of the things that need to be done in order to start practicing get done, right?"
    },
    {
      "start": 844.51,
      "end": 856.0,
      "text": "Now, one of the things when I was ready to actually start practicing was I looked in online databases and songbooks for how to play songs."
    },
    {
      "start": 856.0,
      "end": 865.57,
      "text": "And they say, okay, ukuleles, you can play more than one string at a time, so you can play chords, that's cool, you are accompanying yourself, yay you."
    },
    {
      "start": 865.57,
      "end": 872.48,
      "text": "(Laughter) And when I started looking at songs, I had an ukulele chord book that had like hundreds of chords."
    },
    {
      "start": 872.47,
      "end": 875.53,
      "text": "Looking at this and \"Wow, that's intimidating\"."
    },
    {
      "start": 875.53,
      "end": 882.71,
      "text": "But when you look at the actual songs, you see the same chords over and over, right?"
    },
    {
      "start": 882.71,
      "end": 892.42,
      "text": "As it turns out, playing the ukulele is kind of like doing anything, There's a very small set of things that are really important and techniques that you'll use all the time."
    },
    {
      "start": 892.42,
      "end": 900.23,
      "text": "And in most songs you'll use four, maybe five chords, and that's it, that's the song."
    },
    {
      "start": 900.23,
      "end": 904.99,
      "text": "You don't have to know hundreds, as long as you know the four or the five."
    },
    {
      "start": 904.99,
      "end": 914.71,
      "text": "So, while I was doing my research, I found a wonderful little medley of pop songs by a band called Axis of Awesome."
    },
    {
      "start": 914.71,
      "end": 933.06,
      "text": "(Whistles) -- Somebody knows it. -- And what Axis of Awesome says is that you can learn, or you can play pretty much any pop song of the past five decades, if you know four chords, and those chords are G, D, Em and C."
    },
    {
      "start": 933.06,
      "end": 937.93,
      "text": "Four chords pump out every pop song ever, right?"
    },
    {
      "start": 937.93,
      "end": 939.4,
      "text": "So I thought, this is cool!"
    },
    {
      "start": 939.4,
      "end": 942.09,
      "text": "I would like to play every pop song ever."
    },
    {
      "start": 942.09,
      "end": 949.05,
      "text": "(Laughter) So, that was the first song I decided to learn, and I would like to actually share it with you."
    },
    {
      "start": 949.05,
      "end": 949.44,
      "text": "Ready?"
    },
    {
      "start": 949.45,
      "end": 951.43,
      "text": "(Applause) Alright."
    },
    {
      "start": 951.42,
      "end": 954.73,
      "text": "(Music)"
    },
    {
      "start": 963.6,
      "end": 974.65,
      "text": "(Singing) Just a small town girl, living in a lonely world, she took the midnight train going anywhere."
    },
    {
      "start": 974.65,
      "end": 985.01,
      "text": "I heard that you settled down, (Laughter) that you found a girl, that you're married now."
    },
    {
      "start": 985.01,
      "end": 994.54,
      "text": "Every night in my dreams (Laughter) I see you, I feel you, that is how I know you go on."
    },
    {
      "start": 994.54,
      "end": 999.41,
      "text": "(Laughter) I won't hesitate no more, no more."
    },
    {
      "start": 999.41,
      "end": 1002.22,
      "text": "It cannot wait, I'm yours."
    },
    {
      "start": 1002.23,
      "end": 1007.6,
      "text": "'Cause you were amazing, we did amazing things."
    },
    {
      "start": 1007.6,
      "end": 1017.97,
      "text": "If I could, then I would, I'd go wherever you will -- Can you feel the love tonight."
    },
    {
      "start": 1017.97,
      "end": 1023.4,
      "text": "(Laughter) I can't live with or without you."
    },
    {
      "start": 1023.4,
      "end": 1030.89,
      "text": "When I find myself -- When I find myself in times of trouble, mother Mary comes to me, Sometimes I feel like I don't have partner."
    },
    {
      "start": 1030.89,
      "end": 1031.87,
      "text": "No woman, no cry."
    },
    {
      "start": 1031.87,
      "end": 1033.51,
      "text": "Yeah mama, this surely is a dream."
    },
    {
      "start": 1033.5,
      "end": 1035.42,
      "text": "I come from a land down under."
    },
    {
      "start": 1035.42,
      "end": 1038.87,
      "text": "(Laughter) Once a jolly swagman camped by a billabong."
    },
    {
      "start": 1038.86,
      "end": 1052.34,
      "text": "Hey, I just met you, and this is crazy, (Laughter) but here's my number, so call me Hey sexy lady, op, op, op, op, oppan gangnam style."
    },
    {
      "start": 1052.34,
      "end": 1055.93,
      "text": "(Laughter) It's time to say goodbye."
    },
    {
      "start": 1055.93,
      "end": 1065.79,
      "text": "Closing time, every new beginning comes from some other beginning's end."
    },
    {
      "start": 1065.79,
      "end": 1069.86,
      "text": "(Singing and music ends) (Applause)"
    },
    {
      "start": 1076.91,
      "end": 1081.2,
      "text": "Thank you, thank you."
    },
    {
      "start": 1083.01,
      "end": 1084.94,
      "text": "I love that song."
    },
    {
      "start": 1084.94,
      "end": 1090.49,
      "text": "(Laughter) And I have a secret to share with you."
    },
    {
      "start": 1090.5,
      "end": 1099.22,
      "text": "So, by playing that song for you, I just hit my twentieth hour of practicing the ukulele."
    },
    {
      "start": 1099.22,
      "end": 1103.21,
      "text": "(Applause) Thank you."
    },
    {
      "start": 1104.93,
      "end": 1110.75,
      "text": "And so it's amazing, pretty much anything that you can think of, what do you want to do."
    },
    {
      "start": 1110.75,
      "end": 1121.0,
      "text": "The major barrier to learn something new is not intellectual, it's not the process of you learning a bunch of little tips or tricks or things."
    },
    {
      "start": 1121.0,
      "end": 1123.62,
      "text": "The major barrier's emotional."
    },
    {
      "start": 1123.62,
      "end": 1124.75,
      "text": "We're scared."
    },
    {
      "start": 1124.75,
      "end": 1131.54,
      "text": "Feeling stupid doesn't feel good, in the beginning of learning anything new you feel really stupid."
    },
    {
      "start": 1131.54,
      "end": 1135.64,
      "text": "So the major barrier's not intellectual, it's emotional."
    },
    {
      "start": 1135.63,
      "end": 1138.97,
      "text": "But put 20 hours into anything."
    },
    {
      "start": 1138.97,
      "end": 1139.96,
      "text": "It doesn't matter."
    },
    {
      "start": 1139.96,
      "end": 1141.38,
      "text": "What do you want to learn?"
    },
    {
      "start": 1141.38,
      "end": 1143.29,
      "text": "Do you want to learn a language?"
    },
    {
      "start": 1143.29,
      "end": 1144.85,
      "text": "Want to learn how to cook?"
    },
    {
      "start": 1144.85,
      "end": 1147.12,
      "text": "Want to learn how to draw?"
    },
    {
      "start": 1147.11,
      "end": 1148.93,
      "text": "What turns you on?"
    },
    {
      "start": 1148.93,
      "end": 1150.86,
      "text": "What lights you up?"
    },
    {
      "start": 1150.86,
      "end": 1152.89,
      "text": "Go out and do that thing."
    },
    {
      "start": 1152.89,
      "end": 1154.75,
      "text": "It only takes 20 hours."
    },
    {
      "start": 1154.75,
      "end": 1156.1,
      "text": "Have fun."
    },
    {
      "start": 1156.09,
      "end": 1159.06,
      "text": "(Applause)"
    }
  ],
  "iCvmsMzlF7o": [
    {
      "start": 16.86,
      "end": 22.39,
      "text": "So, I'll start with this: a couple years ago, an event planner called me because I was going to do a speaking event."
    },
    {
      "start": 22.42,
      "end": 27.7,
      "text": "And she called, and she said, \"I'm really struggling with how to write about you on the little flyer.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 27.73,
      "end": 29.78,
      "text": "And I thought, \"Well, what's the struggle?\""
    },
    {
      "start": 30.49,
      "end": 40.3,
      "text": "And she said, \"Well, I saw you speak, and I'm going to call you a researcher, I think, but I'm afraid if I call you a researcher, no one will come, because they'll think you're boring and irrelevant.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 40.32,
      "end": 41.32,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 41.34,
      "end": 42.92,
      "text": "And I was like, \"Okay.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 42.95,
      "end": 46.67,
      "text": "And she said, \"But the thing I liked about your talk is you're a storyteller."
    },
    {
      "start": 46.69,
      "end": 49.4,
      "text": "So I think what I'll do is just call you a storyteller.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 49.99,
      "end": 55.3,
      "text": "And of course, the academic, insecure part of me was like, \"You're going to call me a what?\""
    },
    {
      "start": 55.32,
      "end": 57.87,
      "text": "And she said, \"I'm going to call you a storyteller.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 57.9,
      "end": 60.75,
      "text": "And I was like, \"Why not 'magic pixie'?\""
    },
    {
      "start": 60.77,
      "end": 63.25,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 63.65,
      "end": 66.93,
      "text": "I was like, \"Let me think about this for a second.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 67.29,
      "end": 69.83,
      "text": "I tried to call deep on my courage."
    },
    {
      "start": 69.85,
      "end": 72.96,
      "text": "And I thought, you know, I am a storyteller."
    },
    {
      "start": 72.99,
      "end": 74.39,
      "text": "I'm a qualitative researcher."
    },
    {
      "start": 74.42,
      "end": 76.14,
      "text": "I collect stories; that's what I do."
    },
    {
      "start": 76.66,
      "end": 79.56,
      "text": "And maybe stories are just data with a soul."
    },
    {
      "start": 79.58,
      "end": 81.96,
      "text": "And maybe I'm just a storyteller."
    },
    {
      "start": 81.99,
      "end": 83.65,
      "text": "And so I said, \"You know what?"
    },
    {
      "start": 83.67,
      "end": 86.31,
      "text": "Why don't you just say I'm a researcher-storyteller.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 86.34,
      "end": 88.07,
      "text": "And she went, \"Ha ha."
    },
    {
      "start": 88.07,
      "end": 89.97,
      "text": "There's no such thing.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 89.99,
      "end": 91.67,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 91.7,
      "end": 109.44,
      "text": "So I'm a researcher-storyteller, and I'm going to talk to you today -- we're talking about expanding perception -- and so I want to talk to you and tell some stories about a piece of my research that fundamentally expanded my perception and really actually changed the way that I live and love and work and parent."
    },
    {
      "start": 110.09,
      "end": 112.22,
      "text": "And this is where my story starts."
    },
    {
      "start": 112.99,
      "end": 123.65,
      "text": "When I was a young researcher, doctoral student, my first year, I had a research professor who said to us, \"Here's the thing, if you cannot measure it, it does not exist.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 125.37,
      "end": 127.96,
      "text": "And I thought he was just sweet-talking me."
    },
    {
      "start": 128.34,
      "end": 130.78,
      "text": "I was like, \"Really?\" and he was like, \"Absolutely.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 130.8,
      "end": 144.7,
      "text": "And so you have to understand that I have a bachelor's and a master's in social work, and I was getting my Ph.D. in social work, so my entire academic career was surrounded by people who kind of believed in the \"life's messy, love it.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 145.47,
      "end": 152.71,
      "text": "And I'm more of the, \"life's messy, clean it up, organize it and put it into a bento box.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 152.73,
      "end": 154.71,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 155.02,
      "end": 165.81,
      "text": "And so to think that I had found my way, to found a career that takes me -- really, one of the big sayings in social work is, \"Lean into the discomfort of the work.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 166.54,
      "end": 171.37,
      "text": "And I'm like, knock discomfort upside the head and move it over and get all A's."
    },
    {
      "start": 171.4,
      "end": 173.31,
      "text": "That was my mantra."
    },
    {
      "start": 174.99,
      "end": 176.97,
      "text": "So I was very excited about this."
    },
    {
      "start": 176.99,
      "end": 182.97,
      "text": "And so I thought, you know what, this is the career for me, because I am interested in some messy topics."
    },
    {
      "start": 182.99,
      "end": 185.36,
      "text": "But I want to be able to make them not messy."
    },
    {
      "start": 185.38,
      "end": 186.7,
      "text": "I want to understand them."
    },
    {
      "start": 186.73,
      "end": 192.31,
      "text": "I want to hack into these things that I know are important and lay the code out for everyone to see."
    },
    {
      "start": 192.99,
      "end": 195.65,
      "text": "So where I started was with connection."
    },
    {
      "start": 195.67,
      "end": 203.82,
      "text": "Because, by the time you're a social worker for 10 years, what you realize is that connection is why we're here."
    },
    {
      "start": 203.84,
      "end": 206.22,
      "text": "It's what gives purpose and meaning to our lives."
    },
    {
      "start": 207.08,
      "end": 208.87,
      "text": "This is what it's all about."
    },
    {
      "start": 208.89,
      "end": 223.37,
      "text": "It doesn't matter whether you talk to people who work in social justice, mental health and abuse and neglect, what we know is that connection, the ability to feel connected, is -- neurobiologically that's how we're wired -- it's why we're here."
    },
    {
      "start": 223.39,
      "end": 226.4,
      "text": "So I thought, you know what, I'm going to start with connection."
    },
    {
      "start": 227.07,
      "end": 236.7,
      "text": "Well, you know that situation where you get an evaluation from your boss, and she tells you 37 things that you do really awesome, and one \"opportunity for growth?\""
    },
    {
      "start": 236.73,
      "end": 238.54,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 239.2,
      "end": 242.67,
      "text": "And all you can think about is that opportunity for growth, right?"
    },
    {
      "start": 242.69,
      "end": 250.39,
      "text": "Well, apparently this is the way my work went as well, because, when you ask people about love, they tell you about heartbreak."
    },
    {
      "start": 250.41,
      "end": 257.02,
      "text": "When you ask people about belonging, they'll tell you their most excruciating experiences of being excluded."
    },
    {
      "start": 257.05,
      "end": 262.11,
      "text": "And when you ask people about connection, the stories they told me were about disconnection."
    },
    {
      "start": 263.12,
      "end": 274.67,
      "text": "So very quickly -- really about six weeks into this research -- I ran into this unnamed thing that absolutely unraveled connection in a way that I didn't understand or had never seen."
    },
    {
      "start": 275.11,
      "end": 279.34,
      "text": "And so I pulled back out of the research and thought, I need to figure out what this is."
    },
    {
      "start": 279.36,
      "end": 281.54,
      "text": "And it turned out to be shame."
    },
    {
      "start": 283.21,
      "end": 294.96,
      "text": "And shame is really easily understood as the fear of disconnection: Is there something about me that, if other people know it or see it, that I won't be worthy of connection?"
    },
    {
      "start": 295.59,
      "end": 298.97,
      "text": "The things I can tell you about it: It's universal; we all have it."
    },
    {
      "start": 298.99,
      "end": 303.34,
      "text": "The only people who don't experience shame have no capacity for human empathy or connection."
    },
    {
      "start": 303.37,
      "end": 307.56,
      "text": "No one wants to talk about it, and the less you talk about it, the more you have it."
    },
    {
      "start": 309.0,
      "end": 316.06,
      "text": "What underpinned this shame, this \"I'm not good enough,\" -- which, we all know that feeling: \"I'm not blank enough."
    },
    {
      "start": 316.06,
      "end": 321.15,
      "text": "I'm not thin enough, rich enough, beautiful enough, smart enough, promoted enough.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 321.17,
      "end": 326.15,
      "text": "The thing that underpinned this was excruciating vulnerability."
    },
    {
      "start": 326.86,
      "end": 334.74,
      "text": "This idea of, in order for connection to happen, we have to allow ourselves to be seen, really seen."
    },
    {
      "start": 336.06,
      "end": 338.23,
      "text": "And you know how I feel about vulnerability."
    },
    {
      "start": 338.23,
      "end": 339.26,
      "text": "I hate vulnerability."
    },
    {
      "start": 339.28,
      "end": 343.78,
      "text": "And so I thought, this is my chance to beat it back with my measuring stick."
    },
    {
      "start": 343.81,
      "end": 353.6,
      "text": "I'm going in, I'm going to figure this stuff out, I'm going to spend a year, I'm going to totally deconstruct shame, I'm going to understand how vulnerability works, and I'm going to outsmart it."
    },
    {
      "start": 354.64,
      "end": 356.91,
      "text": "So I was ready, and I was really excited."
    },
    {
      "start": 360.24,
      "end": 362.38,
      "text": "As you know, it's not going to turn out well."
    },
    {
      "start": 362.41,
      "end": 364.92,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 364.94,
      "end": 366.53,
      "text": "You know this."
    },
    {
      "start": 366.56,
      "end": 370.57,
      "text": "So, I could tell you a lot about shame, but I'd have to borrow everyone else's time."
    },
    {
      "start": 370.6,
      "end": 378.74,
      "text": "But here's what I can tell you that it boils down to -- and this may be one of the most important things that I've ever learned in the decade of doing this research."
    },
    {
      "start": 380.07,
      "end": 388.96,
      "text": "My one year turned into six years: Thousands of stories, hundreds of long interviews, focus groups."
    },
    {
      "start": 388.99,
      "end": 397.25,
      "text": "At one point, people were sending me journal pages and sending me their stories -- thousands of pieces of data in six years."
    },
    {
      "start": 397.27,
      "end": 398.96,
      "text": "And I kind of got a handle on it."
    },
    {
      "start": 398.99,
      "end": 402.09,
      "text": "I kind of understood, this is what shame is, this is how it works."
    },
    {
      "start": 403.45,
      "end": 431.31,
      "text": "I wrote a book, I published a theory, but something was not okay -- and what it was is that, if I roughly took the people I interviewed and divided them into people who really have a sense of worthiness -- that's what this comes down to, a sense of worthiness -- they have a strong sense of love and belonging -- and folks who struggle for it, and folks who are always wondering if they're good enough."
    },
    {
      "start": 431.33,
      "end": 438.62,
      "text": "There was only one variable that separated the people who have a strong sense of love and belonging and the people who really struggle for it."
    },
    {
      "start": 438.64,
      "end": 444.78,
      "text": "And that was, the people who have a strong sense of love and belonging believe they're worthy of love and belonging."
    },
    {
      "start": 445.7,
      "end": 446.85,
      "text": "That's it."
    },
    {
      "start": 447.5,
      "end": 448.99,
      "text": "They believe they're worthy."
    },
    {
      "start": 450.74,
      "end": 464.46,
      "text": "And to me, the hard part of the one thing that keeps us out of connection is our fear that we're not worthy of connection, was something that, personally and professionally, I felt like I needed to understand better."
    },
    {
      "start": 464.81,
      "end": 474.54,
      "text": "So what I did is I took all of the interviews where I saw worthiness, where I saw people living that way, and just looked at those."
    },
    {
      "start": 475.31,
      "end": 477.36,
      "text": "What do these people have in common?"
    },
    {
      "start": 477.39,
      "end": 482.03,
      "text": "I have a slight office supply addiction, but that's another talk."
    },
    {
      "start": 482.05,
      "end": 488.17,
      "text": "So I had a manila folder, and I had a Sharpie, and I was like, what am I going to call this research?"
    },
    {
      "start": 488.2,
      "end": 491.19,
      "text": "And the first words that came to my mind were \"whole-hearted.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 491.81,
      "end": 495.33,
      "text": "These are whole-hearted people, living from this deep sense of worthiness."
    },
    {
      "start": 495.35,
      "end": 500.16,
      "text": "So I wrote at the top of the manila folder, and I started looking at the data."
    },
    {
      "start": 500.18,
      "end": 509.78,
      "text": "In fact, I did it first in a four-day, very intensive data analysis, where I went back, pulled the interviews, the stories, pulled the incidents."
    },
    {
      "start": 509.8,
      "end": 510.64,
      "text": "What's the theme?"
    },
    {
      "start": 510.64,
      "end": 511.58,
      "text": "What's the pattern?"
    },
    {
      "start": 512.37,
      "end": 522.12,
      "text": "My husband left town with the kids because I always go into this Jackson Pollock crazy thing, where I'm just writing and in my researcher mode."
    },
    {
      "start": 523.62,
      "end": 525.17,
      "text": "And so here's what I found."
    },
    {
      "start": 528.11,
      "end": 530.96,
      "text": "What they had in common was a sense of courage."
    },
    {
      "start": 531.62,
      "end": 534.72,
      "text": "And I want to separate courage and bravery for you for a minute."
    },
    {
      "start": 534.75,
      "end": 546.29,
      "text": "Courage, the original definition of courage, when it first came into the English language -- it's from the Latin word \"cor,\" meaning \"heart\" -- and the original definition was to tell the story of who you are with your whole heart."
    },
    {
      "start": 547.06,
      "end": 551.23,
      "text": "And so these folks had, very simply, the courage to be imperfect."
    },
    {
      "start": 553.63,
      "end": 563.85,
      "text": "They had the compassion to be kind to themselves first and then to others, because, as it turns out, we can't practice compassion with other people if we can't treat ourselves kindly."
    },
    {
      "start": 564.26,
      "end": 580.79,
      "text": "And the last was they had connection, and -- this was the hard part -- as a result of authenticity, they were willing to let go of who they thought they should be in order to be who they were, which you have to absolutely do that for connection."
    },
    {
      "start": 583.32,
      "end": 593.99,
      "text": "The other thing that they had in common was this: They fully embraced vulnerability."
    },
    {
      "start": 595.68,
      "end": 602.33,
      "text": "They believed that what made them vulnerable made them beautiful."
    },
    {
      "start": 606.14,
      "end": 615.32,
      "text": "They didn't talk about vulnerability being comfortable, nor did they really talk about it being excruciating -- as I had heard it earlier in the shame interviewing."
    },
    {
      "start": 615.34,
      "end": 617.57,
      "text": "They just talked about it being necessary."
    },
    {
      "start": 618.63,
      "end": 622.61,
      "text": "They talked about the willingness to say, \"I love you\" first ..."
    },
    {
      "start": 624.38,
      "end": 629.75,
      "text": "the willingness to do something where there are no guarantees ..."
    },
    {
      "start": 631.28,
      "end": 636.92,
      "text": "the willingness to breathe through waiting for the doctor to call after your mammogram."
    },
    {
      "start": 638.63,
      "end": 643.37,
      "text": "They're willing to invest in a relationship that may or may not work out."
    },
    {
      "start": 644.47,
      "end": 646.34,
      "text": "They thought this was fundamental."
    },
    {
      "start": 647.44,
      "end": 650.06,
      "text": "I personally thought it was betrayal."
    },
    {
      "start": 650.85,
      "end": 664.19,
      "text": "I could not believe I had pledged allegiance to research, where our job -- you know, the definition of research is to control and predict, to study phenomena for the explicit reason to control and predict."
    },
    {
      "start": 664.22,
      "end": 674.31,
      "text": "And now my mission to control and predict had turned up the answer that the way to live is with vulnerability and to stop controlling and predicting."
    },
    {
      "start": 674.33,
      "end": 684.97,
      "text": "This led to a little breakdown -- (Laughter) -- which actually looked more like this."
    },
    {
      "start": 684.99,
      "end": 686.48,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 686.51,
      "end": 688.49,
      "text": "And it did."
    },
    {
      "start": 688.51,
      "end": 691.69,
      "text": "I call it a breakdown; my therapist calls it a spiritual awakening."
    },
    {
      "start": 691.71,
      "end": 692.94,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 692.97,
      "end": 697.19,
      "text": "A spiritual awakening sounds better than breakdown, but I assure you, it was a breakdown."
    },
    {
      "start": 697.21,
      "end": 700.11,
      "text": "And I had to put my data away and go find a therapist."
    },
    {
      "start": 700.14,
      "end": 705.63,
      "text": "Let me tell you something: you know who you are when you call your friends and say, \"I think I need to see somebody."
    },
    {
      "start": 705.66,
      "end": 707.47,
      "text": "Do you have any recommendations?\""
    },
    {
      "start": 707.49,
      "end": 711.7,
      "text": "Because about five of my friends were like, \"Wooo, I wouldn't want to be your therapist.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 711.73,
      "end": 714.47,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 714.49,
      "end": 716.47,
      "text": "I was like, \"What does that mean?\""
    },
    {
      "start": 716.49,
      "end": 719.7,
      "text": "And they're like, \"I'm just saying, you know."
    },
    {
      "start": 719.72,
      "end": 721.7,
      "text": "Don't bring your measuring stick.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 721.73,
      "end": 724.47,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 724.49,
      "end": 725.69,
      "text": "I was like, \"Okay.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 726.54,
      "end": 728.37,
      "text": "So I found a therapist."
    },
    {
      "start": 728.4,
      "end": 736.4,
      "text": "My first meeting with her, Diana -- I brought in my list of the way the whole-hearted live, and I sat down."
    },
    {
      "start": 736.43,
      "end": 738.24,
      "text": "And she said, \"How are you?\""
    },
    {
      "start": 738.26,
      "end": 740.77,
      "text": "And I said, \"I'm great."
    },
    {
      "start": 740.77,
      "end": 741.86,
      "text": "I'm okay.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 741.88,
      "end": 743.4,
      "text": "She said, \"What's going on?\""
    },
    {
      "start": 743.43,
      "end": 751.28,
      "text": "And this is a therapist who sees therapists, because we have to go to those, because their B.S. meters are good."
    },
    {
      "start": 751.31,
      "end": 753.29,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 753.74,
      "end": 757.57,
      "text": "And so I said, \"Here's the thing, I'm struggling.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 757.59,
      "end": 759.4,
      "text": "And she said, \"What's the struggle?\""
    },
    {
      "start": 760.44,
      "end": 762.7,
      "text": "And I said, \"Well, I have a vulnerability issue."
    },
    {
      "start": 762.73,
      "end": 777.41,
      "text": "And I know that vulnerability is the core of shame and fear and our struggle for worthiness, but it appears that it's also the birthplace of joy, of creativity, of belonging, of love."
    },
    {
      "start": 777.78,
      "end": 783.22,
      "text": "And I think I have a problem, and I need some help.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 783.24,
      "end": 788.41,
      "text": "And I said, \"But here's the thing: no family stuff, no childhood shit.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 788.43,
      "end": 790.41,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 790.43,
      "end": 793.41,
      "text": "\"I just need some strategies.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 793.43,
      "end": 797.41,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 797.43,
      "end": 801.01,
      "text": "(Applause)"
    },
    {
      "start": 801.04,
      "end": 802.6,
      "text": "Thank you."
    },
    {
      "start": 804.28,
      "end": 805.76,
      "text": "So she goes like this."
    },
    {
      "start": 807.43,
      "end": 809.79,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 809.81,
      "end": 812.41,
      "text": "And then I said, \"It's bad, right?\""
    },
    {
      "start": 812.43,
      "end": 815.41,
      "text": "And she said, \"It's neither good nor bad.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 815.43,
      "end": 817.26,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 817.28,
      "end": 818.91,
      "text": "\"It just is what it is.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 819.66,
      "end": 822.4,
      "text": "And I said, \"Oh my God, this is going to suck.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 822.43,
      "end": 824.38,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 825.59,
      "end": 827.84,
      "text": "And it did, and it didn't."
    },
    {
      "start": 827.87,
      "end": 829.93,
      "text": "And it took about a year."
    },
    {
      "start": 829.96,
      "end": 838.08,
      "text": "And you know how there are people that, when they realize that vulnerability and tenderness are important, that they surrender and walk into it."
    },
    {
      "start": 839.23,
      "end": 843.62,
      "text": "A: that's not me, and B: I don't even hang out with people like that."
    },
    {
      "start": 843.64,
      "end": 846.41,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 846.43,
      "end": 848.52,
      "text": "For me, it was a yearlong street fight."
    },
    {
      "start": 849.75,
      "end": 850.92,
      "text": "It was a slugfest."
    },
    {
      "start": 851.34,
      "end": 853.17,
      "text": "Vulnerability pushed, I pushed back."
    },
    {
      "start": 853.59,
      "end": 858.4,
      "text": "I lost the fight, but probably won my life back."
    },
    {
      "start": 858.73,
      "end": 871.41,
      "text": "And so then I went back into the research and spent the next couple of years really trying to understand what they, the whole-hearted, what choices they were making, and what we are doing with vulnerability."
    },
    {
      "start": 871.43,
      "end": 873.77,
      "text": "Why do we struggle with it so much?"
    },
    {
      "start": 873.79,
      "end": 875.95,
      "text": "Am I alone in struggling with vulnerability?"
    },
    {
      "start": 877.19,
      "end": 879.89,
      "text": "No. So this is what I learned."
    },
    {
      "start": 881.96,
      "end": 886.27,
      "text": "We numb vulnerability -- when we're waiting for the call."
    },
    {
      "start": 886.29,
      "end": 891.47,
      "text": "It was funny, I sent something out on Twitter and on Facebook that says, \"How would you define vulnerability?"
    },
    {
      "start": 891.5,
      "end": 893.05,
      "text": "What makes you feel vulnerable?\""
    },
    {
      "start": 893.07,
      "end": 895.79,
      "text": "And within an hour and a half, I had 150 responses."
    },
    {
      "start": 895.82,
      "end": 898.79,
      "text": "Because I wanted to know what's out there."
    },
    {
      "start": 901.2,
      "end": 918.43,
      "text": "Having to ask my husband for help because I'm sick, and we're newly married; initiating sex with my husband; initiating sex with my wife; being turned down; asking someone out; waiting for the doctor to call back; getting laid off; laying off people."
    },
    {
      "start": 918.45,
      "end": 919.85,
      "text": "This is the world we live in."
    },
    {
      "start": 920.96,
      "end": 923.93,
      "text": "We live in a vulnerable world."
    },
    {
      "start": 923.95,
      "end": 926.89,
      "text": "And one of the ways we deal with it is we numb vulnerability."
    },
    {
      "start": 927.69,
      "end": 936.86,
      "text": "And I think there's evidence -- and it's not the only reason this evidence exists, but I think it's a huge cause -- We are the most in-debt ..."
    },
    {
      "start": 938.54,
      "end": 939.76,
      "text": "obese ..."
    },
    {
      "start": 940.91,
      "end": 945.07,
      "text": "addicted and medicated adult cohort in U.S. history."
    },
    {
      "start": 948.32,
      "end": 954.75,
      "text": "The problem is -- and I learned this from the research -- that you cannot selectively numb emotion."
    },
    {
      "start": 955.29,
      "end": 957.62,
      "text": "You can't say, here's the bad stuff."
    },
    {
      "start": 958.43,
      "end": 962.51,
      "text": "Here's vulnerability, here's grief, here's shame, here's fear, here's disappointment."
    },
    {
      "start": 962.53,
      "end": 964.41,
      "text": "I don't want to feel these."
    },
    {
      "start": 964.43,
      "end": 967.31,
      "text": "I'm going to have a couple of beers and a banana nut muffin."
    },
    {
      "start": 967.33,
      "end": 970.02,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 970.04,
      "end": 971.91,
      "text": "I don't want to feel these."
    },
    {
      "start": 971.94,
      "end": 973.92,
      "text": "And I know that's knowing laughter."
    },
    {
      "start": 973.94,
      "end": 976.41,
      "text": "I hack into your lives for a living."
    },
    {
      "start": 976.43,
      "end": 978.41,
      "text": "God."
    },
    {
      "start": 978.43,
      "end": 980.98,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 981.0,
      "end": 986.41,
      "text": "You can't numb those hard feelings without numbing the other affects, our emotions."
    },
    {
      "start": 986.44,
      "end": 987.89,
      "text": "You cannot selectively numb."
    },
    {
      "start": 987.91,
      "end": 995.73,
      "text": "So when we numb those, we numb joy, we numb gratitude, we numb happiness."
    },
    {
      "start": 997.15,
      "end": 1006.59,
      "text": "And then, we are miserable, and we are looking for purpose and meaning, and then we feel vulnerable, so then we have a couple of beers and a banana nut muffin."
    },
    {
      "start": 1006.62,
      "end": 1009.99,
      "text": "And it becomes this dangerous cycle."
    },
    {
      "start": 1011.09,
      "end": 1016.22,
      "text": "One of the things that I think we need to think about is why and how we numb."
    },
    {
      "start": 1016.93,
      "end": 1019.01,
      "text": "And it doesn't just have to be addiction."
    },
    {
      "start": 1020.48,
      "end": 1023.85,
      "text": "The other thing we do is we make everything that's uncertain certain."
    },
    {
      "start": 1025.43,
      "end": 1030.52,
      "text": "Religion has gone from a belief in faith and mystery to certainty."
    },
    {
      "start": 1030.54,
      "end": 1031.78,
      "text": "\"I'm right, you're wrong."
    },
    {
      "start": 1031.78,
      "end": 1032.22,
      "text": "Shut up.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 1034.19,
      "end": 1035.41,
      "text": "That's it."
    },
    {
      "start": 1036.61,
      "end": 1037.88,
      "text": "Just certain."
    },
    {
      "start": 1038.34,
      "end": 1042.17,
      "text": "The more afraid we are, the more vulnerable we are, the more afraid we are."
    },
    {
      "start": 1042.19,
      "end": 1044.2,
      "text": "This is what politics looks like today."
    },
    {
      "start": 1044.22,
      "end": 1045.9,
      "text": "There's no discourse anymore."
    },
    {
      "start": 1045.92,
      "end": 1047.4,
      "text": "There's no conversation."
    },
    {
      "start": 1047.81,
      "end": 1049.03,
      "text": "There's just blame."
    },
    {
      "start": 1049.06,
      "end": 1051.38,
      "text": "You know how blame is described in the research?"
    },
    {
      "start": 1052.55,
      "end": 1055.05,
      "text": "A way to discharge pain and discomfort."
    },
    {
      "start": 1057.62,
      "end": 1058.81,
      "text": "We perfect."
    },
    {
      "start": 1058.83,
      "end": 1063.86,
      "text": "If there's anyone who wants their life to look like this, it would be me, but it doesn't work."
    },
    {
      "start": 1063.88,
      "end": 1067.5,
      "text": "Because what we do is we take fat from our butts and put it in our cheeks."
    },
    {
      "start": 1067.53,
      "end": 1070.97,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 1070.99,
      "end": 1074.4,
      "text": "Which just, I hope in 100 years, people will look back and go, \"Wow.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 1074.43,
      "end": 1076.95,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 1076.97,
      "end": 1080.4,
      "text": "And we perfect, most dangerously, our children."
    },
    {
      "start": 1080.43,
      "end": 1082.57,
      "text": "Let me tell you what we think about children."
    },
    {
      "start": 1082.59,
      "end": 1085.4,
      "text": "They're hardwired for struggle when they get here."
    },
    {
      "start": 1085.43,
      "end": 1091.29,
      "text": "And when you hold those perfect little babies in your hand, our job is not to say, \"Look at her, she's perfect."
    },
    {
      "start": 1091.32,
      "end": 1096.64,
      "text": "My job is just to keep her perfect -- make sure she makes the tennis team by fifth grade and Yale by seventh.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 1096.67,
      "end": 1097.91,
      "text": "That's not our job."
    },
    {
      "start": 1097.93,
      "end": 1100.07,
      "text": "Our job is to look and say, \"You know what?"
    },
    {
      "start": 1100.07,
      "end": 1104.6,
      "text": "You're imperfect, and you're wired for struggle, but you are worthy of love and belonging.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 1105.5,
      "end": 1106.69,
      "text": "That's our job."
    },
    {
      "start": 1107.1,
      "end": 1111.96,
      "text": "Show me a generation of kids raised like that, and we'll end the problems, I think, that we see today."
    },
    {
      "start": 1111.98,
      "end": 1117.43,
      "text": "We pretend that what we do doesn't have an effect on people."
    },
    {
      "start": 1118.87,
      "end": 1120.5,
      "text": "We do that in our personal lives."
    },
    {
      "start": 1120.53,
      "end": 1123.89,
      "text": "We do that corporate -- whether it's a bailout, an oil spill ..."
    },
    {
      "start": 1125.39,
      "end": 1126.55,
      "text": "a recall."
    },
    {
      "start": 1126.57,
      "end": 1130.66,
      "text": "We pretend like what we're doing doesn't have a huge impact on other people."
    },
    {
      "start": 1131.43,
      "end": 1134.7,
      "text": "I would say to companies, this is not our first rodeo, people."
    },
    {
      "start": 1135.77,
      "end": 1138.44,
      "text": "We just need you to be authentic and real and say ..."
    },
    {
      "start": 1139.92,
      "end": 1140.95,
      "text": "\"We're sorry."
    },
    {
      "start": 1140.95,
      "end": 1142.06,
      "text": "We'll fix it.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 1145.54,
      "end": 1148.31,
      "text": "But there's another way, and I'll leave you with this."
    },
    {
      "start": 1148.33,
      "end": 1154.26,
      "text": "This is what I have found: To let ourselves be seen, deeply seen, vulnerably seen ..."
    },
    {
      "start": 1156.89,
      "end": 1175.01,
      "text": "to love with our whole hearts, even though there's no guarantee -- and that's really hard, and I can tell you as a parent, that's excruciatingly difficult -- to practice gratitude and joy in those moments of terror, when we're wondering, \"Can I love you this much?"
    },
    {
      "start": 1175.04,
      "end": 1177.23,
      "text": "Can I believe in this this passionately?"
    },
    {
      "start": 1177.25,
      "end": 1179.18,
      "text": "Can I be this fierce about this?\""
    },
    {
      "start": 1179.2,
      "end": 1187.2,
      "text": "just to be able to stop and, instead of catastrophizing what might happen, to say, \"I'm just so grateful, because to feel this vulnerable means I'm alive.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 1188.75,
      "end": 1194.08,
      "text": "And the last, which I think is probably the most important, is to believe that we're enough."
    },
    {
      "start": 1194.66,
      "end": 1198.51,
      "text": "Because when we work from a place, I believe, that says, \"I'm enough\" ..."
    },
    {
      "start": 1200.74,
      "end": 1209.24,
      "text": "then we stop screaming and start listening, we're kinder and gentler to the people around us, and we're kinder and gentler to ourselves."
    },
    {
      "start": 1210.12,
      "end": 1211.07,
      "text": "That's all I have."
    },
    {
      "start": 1211.07,
      "end": 1211.6,
      "text": "Thank you."
    },
    {
      "start": 1211.63,
      "end": 1214.22,
      "text": "(Applause)"
    }
  ],
  "w-HYZv6HzAs": [
    {
      "start": 6.96,
      "end": 12.11,
      "text": "In my past life as a soccer coach, once you won a national championship, everyone wants to come play for you."
    },
    {
      "start": 12.11,
      "end": 13.4,
      "text": "Really not true."
    },
    {
      "start": 13.4,
      "end": 18.87,
      "text": "Once you paid them $ 25,000 a year in scholarships, everybody wants  to come play for you."
    },
    {
      "start": 18.87,
      "end": 26.09,
      "text": "And parents would always come to me and they'd say: \"Okay, my son or my daughter wants to come play at your university, what is it that we have to do?"
    },
    {
      "start": 26.09,
      "end": 27.48,
      "text": "You know, what are you looking for?\""
    },
    {
      "start": 27.48,
      "end": 31.37,
      "text": "And being the Socratic professor that I am, I say, well, what does your son or daughter do?"
    },
    {
      "start": 31.37,
      "end": 33.78,
      "text": "What do they do really well that we'd be interested in?"
    },
    {
      "start": 33.78,
      "end": 36.86,
      "text": "And typically their answers are, well, they've got great vision."
    },
    {
      "start": 36.86,
      "end": 37.84,
      "text": "They're really good."
    },
    {
      "start": 37.84,
      "end": 39.0,
      "text": "They can see the entire field."
    },
    {
      "start": 39.01,
      "end": 42.63,
      "text": "Or, my daughter is the fastest player, there's nobody that can beat her."
    },
    {
      "start": 42.62,
      "end": 45.08,
      "text": "Or, my son's got a great left-footer."
    },
    {
      "start": 45.08,
      "end": 47.48,
      "text": "Really great in the air and can hit every ball."
    },
    {
      "start": 47.48,
      "end": 54.3,
      "text": "I'm like: \"Yeah, not bad; but to be quite honest with you, those are the last things I'm looking for."
    },
    {
      "start": 54.3,
      "end": 55.7,
      "text": "The most important thing?"
    },
    {
      "start": 57.02,
      "end": 58.15,
      "text": "Self-confidence.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 58.16,
      "end": 66.27,
      "text": "Without that skill, and I use the word skill intentionally, without that skill, we are useless as a soccer player."
    },
    {
      "start": 66.27,
      "end": 71.49,
      "text": "Because when you lose sight or belief in yourself, we're done for."
    },
    {
      "start": 71.5,
      "end": 84.24,
      "text": "I use the definition  of self-confidence to be the ability or the belief to believe in yourself, to accomplish any task, no matter the odds, no matter the difficulty, no matter the adversity."
    },
    {
      "start": 84.24,
      "end": 88.53,
      "text": "The belief that you can accomplished it, self-confidence."
    },
    {
      "start": 88.54,
      "end": 90.78,
      "text": "Some of you are saying, \"Great, I don't have it."
    },
    {
      "start": 90.78,
      "end": 91.29,
      "text": "I'm so shy."
    },
    {
      "start": 91.29,
      "end": 93.33,
      "text": "I'll never do that, bla, bla, bla.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 93.32,
      "end": 97.29,
      "text": "And you start to drag all the way down here."
    },
    {
      "start": 97.29,
      "end": 101.88,
      "text": "But, I use the word skill because I believe it can be trained."
    },
    {
      "start": 101.88,
      "end": 104.12,
      "text": "And I'll show you a couple of ways in which we do."
    },
    {
      "start": 104.12,
      "end": 105.55,
      "text": "Hopefully I won't run out of time."
    },
    {
      "start": 105.55,
      "end": 108.96,
      "text": "I don't use any slides because my speech always goes here, or here, or here."
    },
    {
      "start": 108.96,
      "end": 110.8,
      "text": "So we'll see which way we get to."
    },
    {
      "start": 110.8,
      "end": 114.64,
      "text": "The easiest way to build self-confidence: there's no magic button."
    },
    {
      "start": 114.63,
      "end": 116.89,
      "text": "I can't say: \"Hey, this plane is going down, who can fly?"
    },
    {
      "start": 116.9,
      "end": 117.66,
      "text": "Put your hand up.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 117.66,
      "end": 119.38,
      "text": "\"I can, I'm confident!\""
    },
    {
      "start": 119.38,
      "end": 121.92,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 121.93,
      "end": 125.46,
      "text": "Repetition, repetition, repetition."
    },
    {
      "start": 125.46,
      "end": 126.45,
      "text": "Right?"
    },
    {
      "start": 126.45,
      "end": 129.58,
      "text": "What does Malcom Gladwell call it, the 10,000-hour rule?"
    },
    {
      "start": 129.57,
      "end": 130.58,
      "text": "There's no magic button."
    },
    {
      "start": 130.58,
      "end": 133.14,
      "text": "I recruited a goalie from Colombia, South America one year."
    },
    {
      "start": 133.14,
      "end": 135.93,
      "text": "Big, tall 6'3\" man."
    },
    {
      "start": 135.93,
      "end": 138.49,
      "text": "You know, he had hands like stone."
    },
    {
      "start": 138.48,
      "end": 139.77,
      "text": "I thought he was like Flipper."
    },
    {
      "start": 139.77,
      "end": 142.52,
      "text": "Everytime I threw him the ball, down, onto the ground."
    },
    {
      "start": 142.51,
      "end": 144.2,
      "text": "I was like, oh my god, we're in trouble."
    },
    {
      "start": 144.2,
      "end": 148.49,
      "text": "Simple solution: get to the wall, kick a ball against the wall and catch it."
    },
    {
      "start": 148.49,
      "end": 150.35,
      "text": "kick the ball against the wall and catch it."
    },
    {
      "start": 150.36,
      "end": 153.33,
      "text": "His goal was 350 a day for eight months."
    },
    {
      "start": 153.33,
      "end": 160.26,
      "text": "He came back, his hands were calloused, the moisture on his hands were literally gone, he is now playing in Europe."
    },
    {
      "start": 160.27,
      "end": 160.84,
      "text": "Magic?"
    },
    {
      "start": 160.84,
      "end": 164.52,
      "text": "No. Repetition, repetition, repetition."
    },
    {
      "start": 164.52,
      "end": 173.07,
      "text": "The problem is, we expect to be self-confident but we can't be unless the skill, or the task we're doing, is not novel, is not new to us."
    },
    {
      "start": 173.07,
      "end": 184.93,
      "text": "We want to be in a situation where we have so much pressure in that and what I mean, cause pressure builds diamonds, we want to be in a situation where \"hey, I've done this a thousand times\"."
    },
    {
      "start": 184.93,
      "end": 188.49,
      "text": "I did my speech, and I practiced in front of a mirror: bla, bla, bla, bla, bla, bla."
    },
    {
      "start": 188.49,
      "end": 189.71,
      "text": "Hey I'm sounding good."
    },
    {
      "start": 189.71,
      "end": 192.6,
      "text": "And then I went in front of my kids, and my wife."
    },
    {
      "start": 192.6,
      "end": 194.27,
      "text": "I said, oh gosh,  I got a little nervous."
    },
    {
      "start": 194.26,
      "end": 197.41,
      "text": "Then I'd get in front of Glenn Gould, Oh my goodness, I am a little more nervous!"
    },
    {
      "start": 197.41,
      "end": 202.45,
      "text": "By the time I get to the ACG, where 2,500 people, can't say anymore, right?"
    },
    {
      "start": 202.45,
      "end": 212.51,
      "text": "Twenty-five hundred people, where twenty-five hundred people are there, I won't have a single ounce of nervousness because of my ability to practice."
    },
    {
      "start": 212.51,
      "end": 213.42,
      "text": "Right?"
    },
    {
      "start": 213.42,
      "end": 214.99,
      "text": "Over, and over, and over, again."
    },
    {
      "start": 214.99,
      "end": 220.34,
      "text": "The problem with repetition is: how many of us bail after the first bit of failure?"
    },
    {
      "start": 220.34,
      "end": 223.26,
      "text": "How many of us bail after the first bit of adversity?"
    },
    {
      "start": 223.25,
      "end": 230.37,
      "text": "Edison was on that video, and it depends who you ask, there's anywhere from 1,000 to 10,000 tries to build that light bulb."
    },
    {
      "start": 230.37,
      "end": 232.45,
      "text": "1,000 to 10,000."
    },
    {
      "start": 232.45,
      "end": 234.19,
      "text": "J.K Rowling should be on that video."
    },
    {
      "start": 234.19,
      "end": 237.04,
      "text": "Do you know how many publishers she took her Harry Potter book to?"
    },
    {
      "start": 237.04,
      "end": 239.52,
      "text": "I believe the number was 12 or 13..."
    },
    {
      "start": 239.52,
      "end": 243.46,
      "text": "I am pretty confident but after two or three noes I'd be like: \"damn it!\"."
    },
    {
      "start": 243.46,
      "end": 245.05,
      "text": "After six or seven,  I'm like: \"maybe not!\""
    },
    {
      "start": 245.05,
      "end": 249.81,
      "text": "Definitely after nine or ten I'd be looking to be a soccer coach or something else besides an author."
    },
    {
      "start": 249.82,
      "end": 250.74,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 250.74,
      "end": 251.46,
      "text": "Right?"
    },
    {
      "start": 251.46,
      "end": 258.74,
      "text": "I mean, twelve times somebody said no. But, practice, practice, practice, and do not accept failure."
    },
    {
      "start": 258.74,
      "end": 262.08,
      "text": "Maybe it shouldn't be repetition, maybe the answer  should be persistence."
    },
    {
      "start": 262.07,
      "end": 265.96,
      "text": "Because we all repeat something but very few of us really will persist."
    },
    {
      "start": 265.96,
      "end": 268.9,
      "text": "So that's one way  to build self-confidence."
    },
    {
      "start": 268.9,
      "end": 270.04,
      "text": "Get out there."
    },
    {
      "start": 270.04,
      "end": 274.99,
      "text": "Do what you want to do and do not accept no. The other one is self-talk."
    },
    {
      "start": 274.99,
      "end": 277.2,
      "text": "We all have a self-talk tape that plays in our head."
    },
    {
      "start": 277.2,
      "end": 280.18,
      "text": "Anybody go shopping and put on a pair of pants this week?"
    },
    {
      "start": 280.18,
      "end": 284.84,
      "text": "If you're a woman, the first thing that always comes: \"damn I look fat in these pants!.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 284.84,
      "end": 289.08,
      "text": "And if you're a man, it's the opposite: \"Oh god, I got no muscle, I'm so flabby!\""
    },
    {
      "start": 289.08,
      "end": 289.46,
      "text": "Right?"
    },
    {
      "start": 289.46,
      "end": 292.35,
      "text": "We all have this tape that plays in our head."
    },
    {
      "start": 292.35,
      "end": 298.44,
      "text": "As a student, if they asked me the question, it was like: \"Oh, gee please professor don't pick me, I don't know the answer.\""
    },
    {
      "start": 298.44,
      "end": 299.67,
      "text": "I'd look down."
    },
    {
      "start": 299.67,
      "end": 300.33,
      "text": "Right?"
    },
    {
      "start": 300.33,
      "end": 314.38,
      "text": "If you're in the b...when I, let me tell you something, and the VP of business adminis. here, I shouldn't repeat this, but when they hired me as an Athletics director, I sat in an architect's meeting, and I am as dumb as a post when it comes to anything to do with numbers and angles."
    },
    {
      "start": 314.38,
      "end": 321.4,
      "text": "And they are like: the fundibulator valve of the architectural, uh, what do you think doctor Joseph?"
    },
    {
      "start": 321.4,
      "end": 323.95,
      "text": "Uh, let me look into that for you and get back to you."
    },
    {
      "start": 323.96,
      "end": 325.2,
      "text": "(Laughter)"
    },
    {
      "start": 325.2,
      "end": 326.02,
      "text": "Right?"
    },
    {
      "start": 326.02,
      "end": 330.35,
      "text": "I was in a, oh god god, please don't ask me, please don't ask me."
    },
    {
      "start": 330.35,
      "end": 334.03,
      "text": "We all have this negative self-talk that goes in our head."
    },
    {
      "start": 334.04,
      "end": 335.57,
      "text": "Guess what?"
    },
    {
      "start": 335.56,
      "end": 339.24,
      "text": "There's enough people that  are telling us we can't do it."
    },
    {
      "start": 339.24,
      "end": 340.63,
      "text": "That we're not good enough."
    },
    {
      "start": 340.63,
      "end": 343.43,
      "text": "Why do we want to tell ourselves that?"
    },
    {
      "start": 343.43,
      "end": 347.64,
      "text": "We know for a fact that thoughts influence actions."
    },
    {
      "start": 347.64,
      "end": 351.18,
      "text": "We saw it there with the video Sheldon, Dr. Levy showed."
    },
    {
      "start": 351.19,
      "end": 356.58,
      "text": "We know that our thoughts influence actions, why do we want to say that negative self-talk to ourselves?"
    },
    {
      "start": 356.58,
      "end": 359.58,
      "text": "We need to get  our own self-affirmations."
    },
    {
      "start": 359.58,
      "end": 362.32,
      "text": "Muhammad Ali, what was his self-affirmation?"
    },
    {
      "start": 362.32,
      "end": 364.95,
      "text": "I am the greatest!"
    },
    {
      "start": 366.57,
      "end": 368.55,
      "text": "Who else is going to tell you?"
    },
    {
      "start": 368.55,
      "end": 372.69,
      "text": "There need to be quiet moments in your bedroom, quiet moments when you're brushing your teeth."
    },
    {
      "start": 372.69,
      "end": 378.96,
      "text": "That we need to reaffirm: \"I am the captain of my ship and the master of my fate!\""
    },
    {
      "start": 378.96,
      "end": 381.04,
      "text": "That is my affirmation."
    },
    {
      "start": 381.05,
      "end": 391.65,
